items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Excellent, excellent. There was one . . . a couple of little sidebars I just wanted . . . Did you meet musicians like John Neves and Alan Dawson at that time too?
Oh yes. But it’s funny. I did not meet Alan Dawson. I don’t know why I didn’t. But I met John Neves. Didn’t he have a brother . . .
